notes.title: Hello Steam
notes.content:
[b]#Mannaz [/b]is coming. 

Hi, my name is Santiago Dopazo, I'm the project manager of Mannaz. And I'm very happy to be here, to be part of an enthusiastic team. One day maybe I will explain the story behind this project. But not today, today I'm here only to say hello: Here we are, hardworking on this dream, and maybe this game someday will be part of your life too.

@MannazVideogame is a [b]Wizard Battle Simulator[/b] like no other game you have even played, we hope XD

Stay tuned to our project for dev news!
